derivation: from G3816 (παῖς) and a reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω);
def: a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue"))

occurrences.text: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
